item.description: Delhi Police Debunks Rumors of Missing Girls Surge The Delhi Police on Friday dispelled fears of a dramatic increase in missing girls within the city, highlighting that such rumors were being fueled by paid promotions aimed at creating unnecessary panic. item.title: Supreme Court Rejects Jan Suraaj Party's Appeal on Bihar Elections
item.description: Supreme Court Rejects Jan Suraaj Party's Appeal on Bihar Elections The Supreme Court, on Friday, dismissed a petition by Jan Suraaj Party challenging the 2025 Bihar Assembly elections, citing Model Code of Conduct breaches. The party argued that a Rs 15,600 crore scheme affected election fairness. item.description: Two Arrested with Rs 2.28 Lakh Worth of Ganja in Navi Mumbai Navi Mumbai police have apprehended two individuals allegedly found with ganja valued at Rs 2.28 lakh.
